accueil.surtitre: For program directors and project managers
accueil.titre: Running an SAP® program, one milestone at a time.
accueil.intro: The materials to understand and run an SAP program, in the order to read them. The glossary stays open on every page: press “/” to search for a term.
accueil.parcoursSousTitre: From the big picture to day-to-day delivery.
accueil.fluxSousTitre: The four core flows of an SAP ERP, step by step: who acts, which document is created, which accounting entry follows.
accueil.certificationSousTitre: Revision books for the ACT100 and ACT200 certifications.
accueil.frisesSousTitre: The four ways to run an SAP project, each on a timeline, with a running example, how AI helps, and the main failure risks.
accueil.pied: Generic content, with no client-specific information. Nordval, Calvane, Ternova and Alvéa are fictional companies, as are the figures in their examples. Everything opens in the portal: documents in a page-by-page reader, with a button to download them.
